subject: SF Exec Workshop — travel/readiness calendar holds and preferences

Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: on-site exec workshop (Mar 15–18 window)

Hi Alex and Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Helios would like to schedule an in-person executive workshop to finalize integration and rollout priorities. Our preferred window is the week of March 15–18 (flexible). Two main asks from our side:

- Can Redwood hold tentative on-site calendar blocks for March 16 and March 17 (we expect ~8 Helios execs + up to 6 product/engineering partners)?
- We need a short list of available morning slots (PT) for a 90–120 minute exec session; our execs prefer mornings.

We can support a hybrid setup for remote attendees if needed. I'm attaching a short agenda stub (Helios_Exec_Agenda_v0.3.pdf) with objectives so you can size rooms and AV.

Also please confirm who on Redwood will manage travel bookings versus us (Helios) so we can coordinate approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Helios Health

Subject: Re: Proposal: on-site exec workshop (Mar 15–18 window)

Sandeep — thanks for the details and the agenda.

We can tentatively hold March 16 and 17 for an on-site exec session in SF. To help with holds and travel we need:

- Confirmed preferred day (one of the two) for the exec 90–120 min block
- Preferred start window in PT (e.g., 9:00–11:00 PT or 10:00–12:00 PT)
- Final attendee list (names + roles) for name badges and security
- Any special AV or breakout room needs

On travel bookings: Redwood handles travel for our staff. For your execs, Helios can route approvals and we are happy to recommend hotels near the office; Laura (cc'd) will manage hotel blocks and Vivek will handle on-site AV/run-of-show.

I'll attach calendar holds (proposed_holds.ics) for both dates and a short prelim travel checklist. If March 16 works for you, we'll mark 9:00–11:00 PT as the preferred exec window unless you ask otherwise.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Alex — quick reply from the exec team.

March 16 is preferable. Morning block 9:00–11:00 PT works best for our CEO + CTO. Attendee list below (will share names/roles formally by next Wed):

- Arun Malik, CEO
- Priya Shah, CTO
- Sandeep Rao, Dir. Strategic Partnerships
- Product leads x3 (TBD)

AV: standard hybrid kit + one mic for Q&A.

We'll take hotel recommendations from Laura. Helios will manage travel approvals internally; we appreciate the hotel block help.

Thanks,
Sandeep

Sandeep — thanks for confirming March 16. Per the thread below, we've done the following and need a final sign-off from Helios:

- Calendar: Sent tentative calendar hold for Tue, Mar 16 09:00–11:00 PT (proposed_holds.ics attached). Please accept so it becomes final.
- Venue & AV: Vivek confirmed hybrid AV kit; wireless mic and small breakout room are reserved.
- Hotels: Laura added corporate blocks and shared links in Drive (Hotel_Block_Links.txt).
- Pre-read: We'll circulate the pre-read and runbook by Feb 17.
